summary: Reproduced at the fix parent 13fa9ca2cf41 (also the latest affected commit); the fix could not be evaluated. With Qwen3Moe's settings (interm_dtype=half, out_dtype=float), 4 half tokens through an unquantized BlockSparseMLP raised RuntimeError 'index_add_(): self (Half) and source (Float) must have the same scalar type' at exllamav3/modules/block_sparse_mlp.py:275.
